items.title: 63519_Wild Bill Davison oral history interview
items.q: Joe was playing the clarinet and Bud Freeman played on tenor

ctx.x: Well, Joe - Joe Marsala. Joe was playing the clarinet and Bud Freeman played on tenor and, uh, Bob Casey and the great drummer that got killed in Brooklyn---

items.title: 66100_Bud Freeman oral history interview
items.q: He was riding with Wild Bill

ctx.x:
He was riding with Wild Bill and
they were -- it was on the near North Side of Chicago and
they were struck by another -- sideswiped by another car
and Tesh went through the windshield.

I wasn't -- Wild Bill would remember more about
it than I, because after all --

No, that's beside the point really.
What we are really talking about was the musicians.

Well, good, I think you ought to say something
about Jess, don't you?
